preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 200,000.
The number of special offers is between 0 and 200,000.
The numbers written on the vertices are between 1 and 10^12.
The vertices involved in special offers are valid indices of the vertices.
The cost of special offers is between 1 and 10^12.

postconditions.description: The output is an integer representing the minimum number of coins to make the graph connected.
